info.name: Returns a list of treaties sorted by date of last update.

params.name: format
params.description: The data format. Value can be xml or json.

params.name: offset
params.description: The starting record returned. 0 is the first record.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of records returned. The maximum limit is 250.

params.name: fromDateTime
params.description: The starting timestamp to filter by update date. Use format: YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00Z.

params.name: toDateTime
params.description: The ending timestamp to filter by update date. Use format: YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00Z.

items.docs: Returns a list of treaties sorted by date of last update.
